package.description: Use a phone or tablet browser as a Windows 11 trackpad, keyboard, and remote.

en-US.description: Use a phone or tablet browser as a Windows 11 trackpad, keyboard, and remote.
en-US.longDescription: Pair a browser with your Windows 11 PC to control it from a phone, tablet, or another computer. View the PC screen, manage files, and control presentations and media. An optional installer component lets a supported phone act as a webcam.
en-US.name: Voltura Air
